Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
Michael Whitbread (mwhit) wrote:
: if a vampire has talbot's chainsaw and no blood, can she still attack
: a vampire
: that turn {since the chainsaw will prevent her from hunting that turn}?

The only action which a vampire that starts the round with no blood can
perform is hunt: the restrictions of the TC prevent the wielder from
hunting. This vampire is thus 'stuck' and can do nothing whatsoever.
